On May 1, 2026, the Office of Administrative Law (OAL) approved the SB 54 Plastic Pollution Prevention and Packaging Producer Responsibility Act Permanent Regulations. These regulations became effective on May 1, 2026.
Please visit SB 54 Plastic Pollution Prevention and Packaging Producer Responsibility Act Permanent Regulations - CalRecycle Home Page for more information about this rulemaking.
